rules::WFP Workforce Input.rules:
SKIPCHECK;
FEEDERS;

# WFP Workforce Input dims: Period, Version, Position, Measure
# WFP Workforce Cost dims: Period, Version, Entity, Cost Centre, Pay Component, Currency, Position, Measure
['FTE'] => DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version,
  ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Home Entity'),
  ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Cost Centre'),
  '_Monthly Base Full',
  ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Salary Currency'),
  !WFP Position, 'Amount');

# WFP Headcount dims: Period, Version, Entity, Cost Centre, Position, Measure
['FTE'] => DB('WFP Headcount', !WFP Period, !WFP Version,
  ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Home Entity'),
  ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Cost Centre'),
  !WFP Position, 'Headcount');

SKIPCHECK;

# Forecast = calculating version: Actual for periods <= the Actuals Cutoff Index
# (read at the position's Home Entity), Working after. Actual/Working stay input.
['Forecast'] = N:
  IF( ATTRN('WFP Period', !WFP Period, 'Period Index')
        <= DB('WFP Assumptions', !WFP Period, 'Forecast', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Home Entity'), 'Actuals Cutoff Index'),
      DB('WFP Workforce Input', !WFP Period, 'Actual',  !WFP Position, !WFP Workforce Input Measure),
      DB('WFP Workforce Input', !WFP Period, 'Working', !WFP Position, !WFP Workforce Input Measure) );

FEEDERS;

# Working FTE is always seeded for an active position — use it as the guaranteed
# source that feeds every input version's downstream cells, including the
# rule-driven Forecast (whose own FTE cell is never an input, so !WFP Version
# alone would miss it).
['Working', 'FTE'] => DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version,
  ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Home Entity'),
  ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Cost Centre'),
  '_Monthly Base Full',
  ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Salary Currency'),
  !WFP Position, 'Amount');

['Working', 'FTE'] => DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, 'Forecast',
  ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Home Entity'),
  ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Cost Centre'),
  '_Monthly Base Full',
  ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Salary Currency'),
  !WFP Position, 'Amount');

['Working', 'FTE'] => DB('WFP Headcount', !WFP Period, !WFP Version,
  ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Home Entity'),
  ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Cost Centre'),
  !WFP Position, 'Headcount');

['Working', 'FTE'] => DB('WFP Headcount', !WFP Period, 'Forecast',
  ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Home Entity'),
  ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Cost Centre'),
  !WFP Position, 'Headcount');

# Budget / Actual FTE feed their own version's downstream cells
['Budget', 'FTE'] => DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, 'Budget',
  ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Home Entity'),
  ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Cost Centre'),
  '_Monthly Base Full',
  ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Salary Currency'),
  !WFP Position, 'Amount');

['Budget', 'FTE'] => DB('WFP Headcount', !WFP Period, 'Budget',
  ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Home Entity'),
  ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Cost Centre'),
  !WFP Position, 'Headcount');

['Actual', 'FTE'] => DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, 'Actual',
  ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Home Entity'),
  ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Cost Centre'),
  '_Monthly Base Full',
  ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Salary Currency'),
  !WFP Position, 'Amount');

['Actual', 'FTE'] => DB('WFP Headcount', !WFP Period, 'Actual',
  ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Home Entity'),
  ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Cost Centre'),
  !WFP Position, 'Headcount');
